identity.name: Heritage Collection Spring Drive GMT
identity.one_liner: The 41mm Spring Drive GMT that became the quietest traveller's watch in the brand's catalogue — Tri-Compax dial, no rotor noise, ±1 second a day.

provenance_events.description: Grand Seiko brings Spring Drive to a 41mm GMT with the Tri-Compax sub-dial layout, the only hi-beat-quartz-accuracy Spring Drive GMT in the brand's mid-tier line.

narrative.story: The SBGE201 is the accessible Spring Drive GMT: 41mm steel, Tri-Compax sub-dial, a 9R66 movement that combines a quartz-regulated glide-wheel with mechanical mainspring for ±1 second/day accuracy. The case is 13.7mm thick.
narrative.collector_notes: Look at the dial under low light — the polished indices and hands are hand-cut by the Shiojiri studio. Lume is exclusive to hands and 12, 3, 6, 9 markers.
